coordinates.triangles_format: site_vertices_m are (Bx,By,Bz), metres, Z up; exact source triangles, not clipped to region

selection.rule: AABB overlaps region; upward face normal Y>=.95 and XZ projected area>=.25m2. Keeps terrain grid/grade strips, rejects steep tuft geometry. Samples choose highest accepted barycentric hit; no analytic floor approximation.

limits: Source geometry only; no new Unreal trace or rendering.
No terrain, floor or collision changes authorized by this evidence.
Front apron/gate and T02 culvert, reference post, photo sightline must remain clear.
One-metre shoulder may be locally steep; use measured drop and avoid placing vegetation where original terrain is hidden beneath existing ramp or plinth.
